```yaml
name: Security Hardening & Detection Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 2 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

jobs:
  security-hardening:
    name: Security Hardening & Detection Quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Install Rust toolchain
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        components: rustfmt, clippy
    
    - name: Cache dependencies
      uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
    
    - name: Check formatting
      run: cargo fmt --all -- --check
    
    - name: Run Clippy
      run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
    
    - name: Run unit tests
      run: cargo test --lib
    
    - name: Run all tests
      run: cargo test --all
    
    - name: Build release
      run: cargo build --release
    
    - name: Security audit
      run: |
        cargo install cargo-audit
        cargo audit
    
    - name: Validate benchmark corpus exists
      run: |
        if [ ! -f "benchmark_corpus.json" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: benchmark_corpus.json not found"
          exit 1
        fi
    
    - name: Run offline evaluator with benchmark
      run: |
        cargo run --release -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json
    
    - name: Run benchmark accuracy validation
      run: |
        cargo run --release -- --benchmark benchmark_corpus.json --threshold 0.85
    
    - name: Validate CORS policy (Phase A1)
      run: |
        # Check that CorsLayer::permissive() is not used
        if grep -r "CorsLayer::permissive" src/; then
          echo "ERROR: Found permissive CORS policy - should be scoped"
          exit 1
        fi
    
    - name: Validate API token auth (Phase A2)
      run: |
        # Check that API token is required for active endpoints
        if ! grep -r "WAF_DETECTOR_API_TOKEN" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: API token validation not implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate consent target validation (Phase A3)
      run: |
        # Check that public suffixes and private IPs are rejected
        if ! grep -r "public_suffix\|private_ip" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: Consent target validation not fully implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate DNS rebinding fix (Phase A4)
      run: |
        # Check for resolved IP pinning implementation
        if ! grep -r "resolved_ip\|ip_pinning" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: DNS rebinding TOCTOU fix not implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate TLS warnings (Phase A5)
      run: |
        # Check for insecure TLS warnings
        if ! grep -r "insecure_tls\|tls_warning" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: Insecure TLS warnings not implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate CSRF protection (Phase A6)
      run: |
        # Check for CSRF protection on POST routes
        if ! grep -r "csrf\|CSRF" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: CSRF protection not implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate VA2 maturity features (Phase C)
      run: |
        # Check for symmetric content-length delta
        if ! grep -r "content_length_delta\|symmetric.*delta" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: VA2 symmetric content-length delta not implemented"
        fi
        
        # Check for ChallengeType enum
        if ! grep -r "ChallengeType\|enum.*Challenge" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: ChallengeType enum not implemented"
        fi
        
        # Check for async VA2 endpoints
        if ! grep -r "virtual-adversary2" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: Async VA2 endpoints not implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate trust features (Phase D)
      run: |
        # Check for SecurityPosture metadata
        if ! grep -r "SecurityPosture" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: SecurityPosture metadata not implemented"
        fi
        
        # Check for deterministic VaReplayBundle
        if ! grep -r "VaReplayBundle\|MD5.*hash" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: Deterministic replay bundle not implemented"
        fi
        
        # Check for prod mode enforcement
        if ! grep -r "WAF_DETECTOR_MODE.*prod" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: Prod mode enforcement not implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate cross-provider negative evidence (Phase B3)
      run: |
        # Check that negative evidence patterns are expanded
        if ! grep -r "negative_evidence\|pattern_group.*43" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: Cross-provider negative evidence not expanded"
        fi
    
    - name: Validate benchmark CI workflow (Phase B5)
      run: |
        # Check that accuracy threshold gate is implemented
        if ! grep -r "threshold.*0\.85\|accuracy.*gate" src/; then
          echo "WARNING: Benchmark accuracy threshold gate not implemented"
        fi
    
    - name: Upload benchmark results
      uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
      with:
        name: WAF Detection Benchmark
        tool: 'cargo'
        output-file-path: benchmark_results.json
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        auto-push: true
        comment-always: true
        summary-always: true
        save-data-file: true
    
    - name: Manual verification - prod mode
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        echo "Manual verification required:"
        echo "1. Verify prod mode rejects missing token"
        echo "2. Verify prod mode blocks insecure TLS"
        echo "3. Run --benchmark against live sites"
        echo "4. Check that all security features are properly enforced"
    
    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      if: always()
      with:
        name: security-audit-results
        path: |
          target/release/waf-detect
          benchmark_results.json
          security_report.md
```
